evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus rules in src/consensus/tx_verify.cpp and src/validation.cpp, governing block header timestamps, coinbase timelocks, legacy sigops limits, and 64-byte transaction invalidity.
rationale: Implements BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules on regtest to mitigate timewarp difficulty manipulation, Merkle tree leaf ambiguity (CVE-2017-12842), and legacy sigops CPU exhaustion. Because it is explicitly disabled on mainnet, testnet, and signet, it carries no immediate mainnet consensus risk or release-blocking urgency, but provides strategic value by enabling evaluation, mutation testing, and fuzzing of proposed soft fork rules in-tree.
